chunks: But she pointed towards him. "How can we talk to one," they said, "who is only an infant in the cradle?"
ai.seo_question: How did the people react to Maryam bringing the infant Jesus?
ai.summary: This verse captures the crowd's incredulity at Maryam presenting her son, as they questioned how they could converse with an infant still in the cradle, setting the stage for his miraculous speech. In Shia exegesis, this moment underscores the divine validation of Maryam's chastity and Isa's unique prophetic status from birth, serving as a clear sign (ayah) of God's power to create as He wills. The dialogue highlights the transition from human skepticism to divine affirmation, reinforcing the concept of 'Kalimah' (Word) from God.
